title: (c) Qualitative properties: positivity, C^∞ regularity, exponential decay of F

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: **Open sub-lemma, part (c).** Must be proved, not asserted: (i) $F>0$ everywhere (Krein–Rutman / strong maximum principle for the elliptic operator); (ii) $F\in C^\infty$ via elliptic bootstrap from $\beta,\mu\in C^\infty$; (iii) exponential decay $F(x)\to0$ as $|x|\to\infty$ via Agmon estimates on the effective Schrödinger operator $-\tfrac D2 u''+V_{\rm eff}u$, with rate governed by $\sqrt{2(V_{\rm eff}-\lambda)/D}$. Each requires the confinement hypothesis from the existence issue and explicit constants.
